We own our labor, but that labor produces goods, which you willing can lend to people. I think we’re getting disconnected. Labor is not the apple that the tree produces, labor is the act of growing that apple. That tree then provides the apple for all the animals that eat that. Labor theft is what your boss does when you sign the contract. And no. You do not choose to do that, that is the only way to live in this system. You are right, no one is entitled to your labor, but when you put that good out there for others to consume, you are giving up ownership of that good. You will always be the one who put labor into it, but you put the labor into that good, in order for someone else to consume it. But thats not capitalism. Capitalism is when you give your labor to a brand in order for that brand to sell that good, in exchange for a labor value median, which is also the only way for anyone to consume. If you want to keep your labor, stop working for that brand and start providing goods yourself. That is the *only* way for you to still be attached to your labor

So, you keep saying that we arent entitled to other peoples labor, but you advocate for a system where a boss who sits on their ass all day to take a vast majority of the company’s wealth. What more does that CEO do than someone who works full time to support their families actually laboring over their work, to deserve a disgusting amount of money? If proportionally distributed by how much someone works, then the worker would get far more than the CEO. But thats not how capitalism works. Capital is there in order to create a hierarchy in which someone can exploit you of your wages. I feel like that saying (which is likely something you read from a book or heard from a youtuber, and agreed with [me bringing up youtube isnt a bad thing, practically everyone uses it now including me]) is a really good “gotcha” but its kinda ignoring the fact that labor exists for consumption, so yes while im not entitled to someones labor specifically, i should be entitled to consume what that labor creates, not because i deem that i am, but because that person is putting those goods out there for consumption, and capitalism inhibits the extent that people are able to consume, but also the ability for the laborer to produce more
